newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHEAT UP, ACTIVE ON STERLING-LED BANDWAGON.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHEAT UP, ACTIVE ON STERLING-LED BANDWAGON.

text.p: LIFFE grains jumped in active trade, with sterling's weakness setting the tone and players dragged in by tight physical supplies and a desire not to get left behind, traders said.
Active March wheat last traded 1.25 stg higher at 92.00 stg, just off a high of 92.75 stg.
March volume was 321 of the total 837 lots on wheat.
Total volume on barley was 217 lots, with 132 on active November, which last traded 0.75 stg higher at 82.25 stg, off a high of 82.65 stg.
The price move bought out buyers and sellers, traders said.
There was active shipper selling in the morning, although it did tail off later, one trader said. And shorts felt to some extent pressured into buying as the market rose, he said.
"They can't buy physical wheat," he said. Co-operatives and merchants featured strongly among the buyers.
